title: Global queue identity joined a VIXEN job to an unrelated worktree command
body: The documented global queue command from this lane joined a running recipeclamp1 cmake build because queue identity did not distinguish cwd/payload; native prepare also replayed the same stale wsl-compile key. Recovery required stopping only this lane's wrappers and retrying with --no-replay --input-key and UT_QUEUE_DYNAMIC_FLOW=0. The queue should key admission/replay by cwd and complete payload, and bound or cache history scans per lane.

title: Native pinned-tool provisioning cannot recover a transient GitHub Ninja download timeout
body: build.bat provision failed twice with winget Ninja-build.Ninja 1.13.1 and 0x801901f8 Gateway timeout from GitHub. The recovery was to reuse the existing rtframe1 VIXEN/.win-native-toolchain cache for this lane, then rerun the queued prepare. Provisioning should accept a documented local pinned-tool cache/source so a transient upstream timeout does not block a native lane.

title: Native configure cannot use the existing ccache when GitHub ccache download fails
body: The queued native configure attempted the pinned ccache 4.13.6 GitHub download, received HTTP 22, then fell back to unavailable sccache and continued un-cached. The configure should consume an existing per-machine or sibling-lane ccache tool cache, or expose a deterministic offline fallback, without an unnecessary network dependency.
